mode: PWAPP (full PWA with manifest + service worker)
description: W3C PWA shell — manifest-driven display, permissions, notifications, badging, share, offline, scope navigation

capabilities.expected: Window opens, loads URL. Splash screen shows during load.

capabilities.feature: Uses startUrl from metadata over argv
capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with manifest start_url. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Loads metadata startUrl, not argv URL. Metadata takes priority.
Window icon loaded from metadata iconPath field.
Full-screen splash with: backgroundColor from manifest, app icon (128x128), app name, BusyIndicator. z:1000.
Splash fades out (400ms animation) when LoadSucceededStatus fires. Also dismisses on LoadFailedStatus.

capabilities.feature: Splash text color adapts to background
capabilities.test: PWAPP with dark backgroundColor vs light backgroundColor
capabilities.expected: White text on dark background, dark text on light. Luminance formula: (0.299*R + 0.587*G + 0.114*B) < 0.5.
No URL bar. No navigation buttons. Only hamburger menu button in header.
PwaToolbar with: back/forward/reload buttons, read-only URL bar, hamburger menu.
Window starts fullscreen automatically. No header at all. showFullScreen() called.

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with display_override:[minimal-ui, standalone] and display:standalone
capabilities.expected: Uses minimal-ui (first supported mode in display_override wins over display field).

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with no displayMode and no displayOverride fields in metadata
capabilities.expected: Defaults to standalone mode (not browser).

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with theme_color:#e91e63 and display:minimal-ui. Launch.
capabilities.expected: PwaToolbar background is #e91e63. Text white (dark background).
Toolbar text is dark. Luminance formula: (0.299*R + 0.587*G + 0.114*B) >= 0.5.
Navigation accepted. Page loads in WebEngineView.
Navigation rejected. Qt.openUrlExternally() opens system browser.

capabilities.feature: Relative scope resolved against base URL
capabilities.test: PWAPP with relative scope '/app/' and url 'https://example.com'
capabilities.expected: Scope resolves to 'https://example.com/app/' via QUrl::resolved().
Navigation accepted (only LinkClickedNavigation type is scope-filtered).

capabilities.test: Web page requests geolocation, camera, notifications
capabilities.expected: Permission auto-granted without user prompt (default=true for installed PWAs).

capabilities.test: Grant permission. Close app. Relaunch. Request same permission.
capabilities.expected: Still granted. Stored in QSettings permissions/{type}.

capabilities.test: Request each: Geolocation, AudioCapture, VideoCapture, AudioVideoCapture, DesktopVideoCapture, DesktopAudioVideoCapture, Notifications, ClipboardReadWrite, LocalFontsAccess
capabilities.expected: All handled by PwaPermissionHandler. Each auto-granted by default.

capabilities.test: Fresh PWAPP install, request permission with no prior QSettings entry
capabilities.expected: shouldGrant() returns true. No QSettings key needed for default behavior.

capabilities.test: PWA sends notification via Notification API
capabilities.expected: Desktop notification via D-Bus org.freedesktop.Notifications.Notify(). Shows app name + icon + title + body. expire_timeout=-1.
WebEngineProfile.pushServiceEnabled=true if Qt supports it. Runtime check: 'pushServiceEnabled' in appProfile.
JS polyfill emits console.info('__QAPP_CMD:badge:5'). D-Bus Unity LauncherEntry signal with count=5, count-visible=true.
D-Bus signal with count=0, count-visible=false. Badge removed from taskbar.
Badge overlay on app icon (com.canonical.Unity.LauncherEntry protocol).
JS polyfill emits __QAPP_CMD:share:JSON. Opens mailto: with subject=title, body=text+url.
Returns true (polyfill always returns true).
PwaHelper.isOnline=false via QNetworkInformation. Red 'Offline' badge top-right (z:998).
PwaHelper.isOnline=true. Badge fades out (300ms opacity animation).

capabilities.test: Load PWAPP, disconnect, navigate within app
capabilities.expected: Service worker serves cached content. App continues working offline.

capabilities.test: Page loads in PWAPP. Check navigator.setAppBadge exists.
capabilities.expected: After LoadSucceededStatus, polyfillScript() injected via runJavaScript().
Polyfills re-injected on each LoadSucceededStatus event.
Badge command parsed and executed. Regular console messages ignored (no action).
Request accepted. Window goes fullscreen.

capabilities.test: Press F11 in any display mode
capabilities.expected: Window toggles fullscreen. Header hides in fullscreen, returns when exiting.
Exits fullscreen. Returns to normal window.

capabilities.test: Enter fullscreen first time for this appId
capabilities.expected: 'Press F11 to exit fullscreen' overlay. Fades after 3s (1s fade duration). z:999. Never shown again for this appId.

capabilities.test: Show hint for appId=A. Launch appId=B, enter fullscreen.
capabilities.expected: Hint shows again for B (separate QSettings key: {appId}/hints/fullscreenHintShown).
Back, Forward, Reload, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Open in Browser, About QApp, License.
Back disabled. Forward disabled. After navigate + go back: both enabled.
Current URL opens in system default browser.
Zoom +0.1 per click (max 3.0), -0.1 (min 0.3). Reset returns to 1.0.
'Reset Zoom' menu item disabled when zoomFactor ~= 1.0.
Zoom increases +0.1 per press. Decreases -0.1 per press.
Zoom factor resets to 1.0.
No 'QtWebEngine/' substring. Removed via regex replace at startup.
Still logged in. ForcePersistentCookies policy.
DiskHttpCache enabled. storageName=appId.

capabilities.test: Install same PWA twice with different appIds
capabilities.expected: Separate cookies, cache, localStorage. storageName derived from appId.
Same x, y, width, height. QSettings category: appId.
FileDialog (SaveFile mode) opens. After save: download bar with filename + progress + cancel.

capabilities.test: Start download, click cancel in download bar
capabilities.expected: Download cancelled. Bar disappears.

capabilities.test: Download large file, observe progress bar
capabilities.expected: Human-readable sizes: 'X.X MB / Y.Y MB', 'X.X KB', 'N B'.

capabilities.feature: Only one download at a time
capabilities.test: Start first download. Click second download link while first active.
capabilities.expected: Second download cancelled. Only first proceeds.
Resume overlay shows (z:900). WebEngine lifecycleState set to Active (0). forceActiveFocus() called. Overlay auto-fades after 2s.

capabilities.feature: No false resume on quick switch
capabilities.expected: No overlay shown (500ms threshold prevents flicker).
QTWEBENGINE_CHROMIUM_FLAGS includes --max-old-space-size=8192. Default: 4096 MB.

capabilities.test: Build with QAPP_DEV_BUILD=ON. Launch. Open localhost:9223.
capabilities.expected: DevTools available on port 9223.

capabilities.feature: QML disk cache disabled in dev build
capabilities.expected: QML_DISABLE_DISK_CACHE=1 set. QML changes visible without rebuild.
PwaAppMenu opens as popup.
